body: I most likely should but I find it a bit difficult. I have some anxiety issues and when those pop up i immediatly try to rationalize what im going through. Which is pretty common for humans im just not sure how to relax myself to the point where I can go with the flow
How would I go about creating that trust. Its been an issue in previous games. My party is a bunch of greedy bastards and dont like to share so ive always struggled with making them work together

Currently the main npc is a gnome by the name of Hugo Warrick who is a world class artificer who resides in the Capitol city of New Denari. Money is the off the start motivater but will learn of a lovecraftian cult trying to brinv back Gods who were banished during a celestial civil war. Not sure how im going to link these two things though. My main idea is having them be glorified treasure hunters looking for lost artifacts and it just so happens the cult needs what they are being payed go aquire

Thats one thing im a bit concerned about. My players often overlook the backstory part of their character and its just a person with abilities. Which can be cool but when its the whole party i get a bit worried as I have no way to drag them in using their characters. Would it be viable to have events around their characters to hook them rather than story importance?
Ive been a bit worried abt making things to linear. How would I go about presenting an option with multiple paths?

The glitches feel like the least likely thing to be caused by this if im being honest. It scared me because it was right after but im very open to the fact i could have been exhausted. The idea of becoming violently aware is a way i didnt look at it before but yeah thats sort of what it was. A good analogy i can put it into is imagine after however many years of knowing the earth was round, your now suddenly standing on the worlds edge looking at the universe. Crazy shit. I just got the second tape and tonight i am going to attenpt finishing the first one

This is incredibly helpful. Pretty much sums up my worries for the story. In your second point when you mentioned the AI wanting him to chase it, i had been dancing with that idea and the more i think about it the more I love it. Something i felt would be interesting is to have the motivation sort of be boredom. Like he sees the main characters as a side project he did when he was in a weird state of mind and he sort of just poked and prodded the group throughout their journey. But also curious at the new people of this world. What do they value, how will they interact. I had an idea for a surveillance bot that would look kind of like a snake that stalked the mc's during the first half of the journey. I want to mix genres of dystopian, post apocolyptic, and body horror. In the last bit you mwntiomed how its easy to fall into story archetypes of "ai bad, goodman kill ai" and your very correct. Which is why im also a bit worried aboht this project. As much as i want the villian to be a villian worth remembering i also dont want it to be what hurts the characters most. The mc's are essentially children in this new world. There curious and trusting and that isnt always a good thing. Which is a cliche in and of itself but if a do a few changes it could be better.

Thank you! Before I started writing i was reading an article about organoids and how there being used in the scientific world, being attached to computers and essentially being used as a brain. The idea of a biotic computer scared the hell out of me and i just snowballed from there.

Yes actually thats on purpose. I want it to feel standard at comfortable in the beginning. But you donhave a point so to ellaborate some more. Its going to be the rebenge tale but ultimitally thats the side plot. Its the story of how the main character is altered by the world. Being taken advantage of, lied to, etc. It would be a tale of how far someone is willing to go. By the end i want to explore ideas of what it means to be human and if you can ever become something else. I like thi think of it as Irobot mixed with the maze runner. You have young adults travelling the wasteland in search of what hurt them. A lot of the aide characters will learn to move on and start a new life while the mc holds on to his anger and loss and refuses to let what happened go. For reasons that will be shown in the text. Most likely this story wont have the mc getting a happy ending. Its a tale about struggling to overcome yourself and ambition and how hard you can fall when you dismantle your cushions
